title: Art By Committee: "Looming Up"
content: Wednesday is the day for pure science fiction wacky goodness. And it’s your chance to pitch in a sketch if you feel like it.For those new to the “Art By Committee” game, we start with an excerpt snipped from an actual science fiction manuscript. You illustrate the text either digitally or traditionally. Below is an example byJames Warhola.Read this week’s challenge below. It’s a real corker. I’ll bet all the solutions will be wildly different!No rules or prizes, just a couple suggestions: please scale your JPEG or PNG files to no larger than 700 pixels across and title the file with your name. Let me know if you want me to link back to you when I post on Wednesday the 16th. Email all answers by Tuesday, April 15 at noon eastern time USA.Tomorrow: Five More Dino Art Tips
